items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you’ll be receiving your National Endowment of the Arts Jazz Masters Award publicly... with Archie Shepp

ctx.x: Oh, no revenge. I never have revenge with exes.

So: Wendy, you’ll be receiving your National Endowment of the Arts Jazz Masters Award publicly at the John F. Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C., on April 4, 2016, with Archie Shepp, Pharaoh Sanders, and Gary Burton. I’m wondering if you’ve thought about what this award means to you, and the implications of the award for your mission, which doesn’t seem to be ending any time soon.

I think that I was completely fine with all this, and I’ve been very busy. I haven’t had a chance to really absorb it, until your director just said what he said about sharing a category with... Say it again.
